description: This file defines a React component for a client-side ingestion interface that allows users to upload different categories of documents, initiate processing, and visualize upload progress and errors.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a number of bytes into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension label from a filename.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for an upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns a string title for each upload category to display in UI.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns a color code associated with each upload category for UI styling.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns the accepted file types string for input.
